# M4 final perf rows (medians of 3, ms per frame unless noted; generated by bench/run-final-rows.mjs)

svg = the committed v2 page; gpu = the frozen deliverable (WebGPU, native rotor, static cache); frame rows were measured on the build just before the final boot-only change (device request in parallel with DL decode), load rows on the final build. "GPU pass Σ" of 0.00 means timestamps were off (read as "–"). desktop = 1280 px DPR 2; phone = 390 px DPR 3, CPU 4× throttle. "GPU pass Σ" only in the *-gputime rows (timestamps on).
